script:
frappe.ui.form.on('Sales Order', { refresh: function(frm) { if (frm.doc.customer) { frm.add_custom_button(__('View Credit Balance (Enhanced)'), function() { frappe.call({ method: "erpnext_enhancements.custom_functions.credit_limit.get_credit_balance_3_enhanced", args: { customer: frm.doc.customer, company: frm.doc.company || "Srinath Collective" }, callback: function(r) { if (!r.message) return; let data = r.message; let breakdown = data.breakdown || {}; let dialog = new frappe.ui.Dialog({ title: __("Enhanced Credit Balance Details"), size: "extra-large", primary_action_label: "Close", primary_action: () => dialog.hide(), fields: [ { fieldtype: "HTML", fieldname: "credit_html", label: "Details" } ] }); let html = `

Credit Summary

Credit Limit:${format_currency(data.credit_limit)}
Total Outstanding:${format_currency(data.outstanding)}
Available Balance:${format_currency(data.balance)}

Outstanding Breakdown

Net GL Position (Invoices after payments):${format_currency(breakdown.gl_net_position || 0)}
Sales Orders (Unbilled):${format_currency(breakdown.so_outstanding || 0)}
Delivery Notes (Unbilled):${format_currency(breakdown.dn_outstanding || 0)}
Total Outstanding:${format_currency(data.outstanding)}
Calculation:
Credit Limit${format_currency(data.credit_limit)}
Less: Total Outstanding-${format_currency(data.outstanding)}
Available Credit Balance${format_currency(data.balance)}
Where Total Outstanding comes from:
Net GL Position ${format_currency(breakdown.gl_net_position || 0)} + SO Unbilled ${format_currency(breakdown.so_outstanding || 0)} + DN Unbilled ${format_currency(breakdown.dn_outstanding || 0)} = ${format_currency(data.outstanding)}

Outstanding Invoices (${data.invoices?.length || 0})

${data.invoices?.length ? `
${data.invoices.map(inv => ` `).join('')}
Invoice Date Total Amount Outstanding Status
${inv.name} ${format_date(inv.posting_date)} ${format_currency(inv.base_grand_total)} ${format_currency(inv.outstanding_amount)} ${inv.status}
` : '

No outstanding invoices

'}

Open Sales Orders - Unbilled Portions (${data.sales_orders?.length || 0})

${data.sales_orders?.length ? `
${data.sales_orders.map(so => ` `).join('')}
Sales Order Date Total Amount % Billed Unbilled Amount Advance Paid Net Pending* Status
${so.name} ${format_date(so.transaction_date)} ${format_currency(so.base_grand_total)} ${so.per_billed}% ${format_currency(so.unbilled_amount)} ${format_currency(so.advance_paid)} ${format_currency(so.net_pending_amount)} ${so.status}
` : '

No unbilled sales orders

'}
*Net Pending = Unbilled Amount - Advance Paid (what affects credit limit)
${data.delivery_notes?.length ? `

Unbilled Delivery Notes (${data.delivery_notes.length})

${data.delivery_notes.map(dn => ` `).join('')}
Delivery Note Date Item Amount Invoiced Amount Uninvoiced Amount
${dn.name} ${format_date(dn.posting_date)} ${format_currency(dn.dn_item_amount)} ${format_currency(dn.invoiced_amount)} ${format_currency(dn.uninvoiced_amount)}
` : ''}

Unallocated Payment Entries (${data.unallocated_payments?.length || 0})

${data.unallocated_payments?.length ? `
${data.unallocated_payments.map(pe => ` `).join('')}
Payment Entry Date Paid Amount Unallocated Amount Reference Status
${pe.name} ${format_date(pe.posting_date)} ${format_currency(pe.paid_amount)} ${format_currency(pe.unallocated_amount)} ${pe.reference_no || ''} ${pe.reference_date ? '(' + format_date(pe.reference_date) + ')' : ''} ${pe.allocation_status}
` : '

No unallocated payment entries

'}
`; dialog.fields_dict.credit_html.$wrapper.html(html); dialog.show(); } }); }); } } }); // Helper functions for formatting function format_currency(amount) { return frappe.format(amount || 0, {fieldtype: 'Currency'}); } function format_date(date) { return frappe.format(date, {fieldtype: 'Date'}); } function get_indicator_color(status) { const statusColors = { 'Draft': 'red', 'To Deliver and Bill': 'orange', 'To Bill': 'orange', 'To Deliver': 'blue', 'Completed': 'green', 'Cancelled': 'red', 'Closed': 'gray', 'Overdue': 'red', 'Unpaid': 'orange', 'Paid': 'green' }; return statusColors[status] || 'blue'; }
